title: User Guide • PassQ
subtitle: Master the lifecycle of your Digital Product Passports in minutes.

tab1_content.title: Your Product Journey: Sofia Real-World Case
tab1_content.intro: Imagine Sofia, owner of the apparel brand «Nordic Apex Gear». She just finished a batch of 200 units of her «EcoDry Alpine Jacket» and needs smart labelling to sell in-store and export to the EU without customs hassles.
tab1_content.step1_desc: Sofia opens PassQ in her browser, fills out the 4 guided steps (identity, materials, ecodesign, and tariff code), and clicks Finish. Her passport is instantly secured with a unique cryptographic signature.
tab1_content.step2_desc: From her dashboard, she downloads the high-res QR code under the global GS1 Digital Link standard and sends it to her printer for care labels and cardboard hangtags.
tab1_content.step3_desc: With one click, she generates the official 3-page customs PDF and JSON-LD data file for her export invoice, proving full EU ESPR 2024/1781 compliance.
tab1_content.step4_desc: When a buyer in Madrid, Paris, or Berlin scans the jacket, they see its origin, materials, and care guides in their native language. Customs inspectors verify authenticity immediately.

tab2_content.title: Guided Creation Wizard (4 Simple Steps)
tab2_content.step1_desc: Set the commercial name, category (Textile, Footwear, Electronics, Furniture), GTIN-13 (EAN) barcode, and country of origin.
tab2_content.step2_desc: Add percentage breakdown for each material (e.g., 85% Recycled Polyester, 15% Membrane) and estimated carbon footprint in kg CO₂e.
tab2_content.step3_desc: Select disassembly tools required and years of spare parts availability. PassQ automatically calculates the EU Ecodesign Score (e.g., 9.2/10).
tab2_content.step4_desc: Enter the HS/TARIC customs code (e.g., 6202.40.00). The browser creates a tamper-evident digital signature to prevent counterfeiting.

tab3_content.title: Catalog Management & Daily Operations
tab3_content.catalog_desc: On your dashboard, the «Managed Digital Passports» table represents your active product catalog.
tab3_content.action_view: View Passport: Open the public passport view seen by consumers and inspectors.
tab3_content.action_qr: Get QR Code: Modal with high-resolution vector QR ready for download or print.
tab3_content.action_del: Delete: Permanently erase the product and cryptographic signatures.
tab3_content.export_desc: Export official 3-page Customs PDFs and W3C/EU standard JSON-LD data packages.

tab4_content.title: What Do Customers & Customs See?
tab4_content.consumer_desc: Pointing any smartphone camera at the label QR automatically detects language and reveals materials, sustainability score, and longevity care instructions.
tab4_content.customs_desc: Customs agents see a green «Cryptographically Verified Authenticity» badge guaranteeing non-tampered HS codes and origin declarations.

tab5_content.title: Privacy & Data Sovereignty (Local-First Architecture)
tab5_content.local_desc: PassQ never stores your product catalogs on centralized servers. All data lives exclusively inside your browser internal storage (LocalStorage / IndexedDB).
tab5_content.backup_desc: Export your entire database in seconds to transfer it to another computer or restore it whenever needed.
tab5_content.wipe_desc: A dedicated permanent purge control resets the application to a clean slate whenever you choose.
